thread:
jess_support: Customer ACCT-9921 reported a billing delta — invoice shows ~11,240 embedding units for 2026-03-02, dashboard shows 7,360. They attached CSV of requests and say discrepancy only affects embedding/rerank calls from one service that sends batched inputs.

miguel_billing: Can you paste account id + invoice line and any sample request payloads? Billing sees ~3.9k unit delta that day.

jess_support: acct: ACCT-9921, invoice line INV-2026-0302-ACCT9921. Excerpt (sanitized):
```
timestamp,route,request_count,billed_units
2026-03-02T09:12:00Z,/v1/embeddings,40,800
2026-03-02T09:12:00Z,/v1/embeddings/batch,300,4,200
2026-03-02T09:13:00Z,/v1/rerank,200,6,240
```
Customer says dashboard shows the second line as 300 requests -> 2,100 billed units (UI), invoice shows 4,200.

aj_ml: Two quick checks: pairwise rerank counting (n*m) vs per-input embeddings, and truncation/retry splitting causing extra billed ingests. Need sample payloads.

tanya_sre: Adding metering-bot trace. If we get request IDs we can pull ingest + metering events. @metering-bot attach traces for INV-2026-0302-ACCT9921 time range 2026-03-02T09:10:00Z..2026-03-02T09:20:00Z

metering-bot: Attached: 1769801234_traces.log.gz (s3://metering-archive/2026/03/02/INV-2026-0302-ACCT9921.gz)

jess_support: Two sample payloads from customer (sanitized):
```
# batch embeddings
POST /v1/embeddings
{ "model": "embed-compact-1", "inputs": ["long doc A...", "long doc B...", "short C"], "batch_id": "b-9001" }

# rerank call
POST /v1/rerank
{ "model": "rerank-1", "query": "q", "candidates": ["c1","c2","c3","c4","c5"] }
```
They said they always send larger batch sizes around 09:12.

aj_ml: From experience, check: 1) pairwise rerank billing vs per-input, 2) gateway retries/truncation that can duplicate ingest events.

miguel_billing: Invoice shows reasons: "embed: batched inputs (per-input accounting)" and "rerank: pairwise-count." The /v1/embeddings/batch line billed double UI — suggests retries or duplicate metering.

tanya_sre: Trace shows an LB retry loop for batch_id b-9001: client->LB 3xx retry -> service processed twice because idempotency header missing. First attempt succeeded, second returned 409 but we still emitted metering event for both.

jess_support: Customer confirms they do not set Idempotency-Key on batch calls. They expected server dedupe but we still emitted two metering events.

aj_ml: That explains doubled billed units for embedding batch. For rerank, check if we expand candidates into pairwise combinations server-side across batch boundaries which could overcount.

metering-bot: Metering events for b-9001: 2 events at 2026-03-02T09:12:04Z and 2026-03-02T09:12:07Z. Both event_type: embeddings.request.ingest size=300 inputs tokens_estimate=120000. Dedup key: null.

miguel_billing: Under current metering we bill per ingest event. Dashboard aggregates by deduped request_id when idempotency present; without idempotency the UI heuristics grouped by batch_id and undercounted. Invoice reflects raw metering events.

jess_support: Customer requests correction/refund and a fix — they use dashboard for internal chargebacks. What's remediation?

tanya_sre: Short-term: refund the duplicate ingest event (~300 inputs -> ~1.4k units) and annotate the invoice. Long-term: enforce idempotency or dedupe metering writes on Idempotency-Key before emitting billable events.

aj_ml: Also add a short server-side guard: if we see identical payload hash within 5s from same connection, suppress duplicate ingest billing and mark as retry. Update API docs to recommend Idempotency-Key for batch endpoints.

miguel_billing: Finance needs event ids and unit totals to process refund. @jess_support please gather event ids (from metering-bot) + units. I'll prepare invoice note template.

jess_support: Compiling event ids and totals, will DM customer with interim explanation and request they include Idempotency-Key on future batch calls. Will raise refund ticket once finance confirms.

tanya_sre: Opening a postmortem card to track dedupe-writes code fix and SDK guidance. Pinging eng runtime for scope.

aj_ml: I'll scope the change (small server-side gate + tests). Thanks team. :thumbsup:

metering-bot: Action items logged: PM-1823 (dedupe on idempotency-key), FIN-402 (refund processing), DOCS-77 (idempotency guidance).
